relationships.evidence_quote: Lower levels of PCr/tCr were observed in the ACC (controls: n = 7, FM: n = 5, p = 0.012; Figure 2(a))

relationships.subject: creatine/total creatine in the ACC
relationships.evidence_quote: There was a negative correlation between Cr/tCr in the ACC and total pain levels (MPQ-T) in FM patients (n = 12, r = −0.579, p = 0.049; Figure 3(a)).

key_findings: FM patients show lower PCr/tCr in the ACC and right insula than controls
